y-m-11-06.title: Nzira dzekupatsanura maswiti 24 mumabhegi
y-m-11-06.topic: Kuenderana pakati pehuwandu hwemabhegi nehuwandu mubhegi rimwe (kana huwandu hwose hwakagadzikana)
y-m-11-06.goal: Tsvaga hukama mutebhura hwekuti huwandu mubhegi rimwe huchinja sei sezvo huwandu hwemabhegi huchiwedzera, gadzira nzira dzakawanda dzinokodzera mamiriro, uye utonge kuti munyaya dzimwe hazvigoneke.
y-m-11-06.material:
Unoda kupatsanura maswiti 24 mumabhegi ane huwandu hwakafanana mubhegi rimwe nerimwe. Unoisa maswiti ose, pasina anosara. Tarisa tebhura.

y-m-11-06.s.s1.hint.0: Kune maceli matatu ega ega, nyora huwandu, musiyano, nemultiple yenhamba mbiri.
y-m-11-06.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga iro rinopa kukosha kumwe chete mumaceli ose matatu.

y-m-11-06.s.s1.o.b: Kana ukawedzera huwandu hwemabhegi nehuwandu hwemaswiti mubhegi rimwe, unogara uchiwana nhamba imwe chete

y-m-11-06.s.s1.r.c: Iyi isarudzo yakatarisa kana kukosha kwakagadzirwa kubva panhamba mbiri kwakafanana mumaceli matatu.

y-m-11-01.title: Nhamba ipi inouya mushure me 2, 4, 8?
y-m-11-01.topic: Mitemo mu number patterns: kutonga kana kutanga kumwechete kunosarudza nhamba inotevera seimwe chete
y-m-11-01.goal: Nzwisisa kuti nhamba dzekutanga mashoma dze pattern dzingasarudze mutemo seimwe chete, gadzira nhamba dzinotevera uchishandisa mitemo yakasiyana, uye utaure kuti unoda kuziva chii chimwe.
y-m-11-01.material: Jihu akaronga makadhi enhamba mumutsetse mumwe. Matatu ekutanga i 2, 4, 8. Jihu akati, “Kadhi rinotevera zvechokwadi i 16!” Nhamba dzose dziri pamakadhi i natural numbers, uye kune mutemo unosarudza nhamba inotevera kubva panhamba iri pamberi.
y-m-11-01.thinking.1: Kugadzira iwe pachako mutemo wakasiyana unotsanangura data imwechete
y-m-11-01.thinking.2: Kutonga kana ruzivo rwakakwana uye kutaura kuti ruzivo rwuzhinji rupi rwunodiwa
y-m-11-01.prereq.0: Kutarisa musiyano nemultiple pakati penhamba dziri padyo mu number pattern (3rd–4th grade level)
y-m-11-01.s.s1.prompt: Unofunga chii nemashoko aJihu “Kadhi rinotevera zvechokwadi i 16”?
y-m-11-01.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora padivi pedivi kuti chii chinochinja uye sei kubva ku 2 kuenda ku 4 nekubva ku 4 kuenda ku 8.
y-m-11-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kunze kwekutarisa 'ka kangani', nyorawo nzira yekutarisa 'zvakawedzerwa zvakadini', uye uenzanise nzira mbiri.
y-m-11-01.s.s1.o.a: 16 yakarurama. Nekuti 2, 4, 8 zvinokura nekuwanza nhamba iri pamberi ka2
y-m-11-01.s.s1.r.a: Zvechokwadi kuti 2, 4, 8 zvinoenderana nemutemo wekuwanza ka2. Asi hausati wayedza kana pane mumwe mutemo unoita nhamba nhatu dzimwechete.
y-m-11-01.s.s1.o.b: Unogona kuziva kana i 16 chete mushure mekutarisa kana pane mumwe mutemo unoita 2, 4, 8
y-m-11-01.s.s1.r.b: Iyi i pfungwa yekusamira mushure mekuwana mutemo mumwe, asi kuyedza kana mumwe mutemo unoita number pattern imwechete.
y-m-11-01.s.s1.o.c: Nhamba dzinoramba dzichikura, saka kadhi rinotevera rinogona kuva chero chakakura kupfuura 8
y-m-11-01.s.s1.r.c: Wakashandisa chokwadi chekuti inokura chete uye hauna kutarisa kuti inokura zvakadini nguva imwe neimwe. Unotarisa hukama pakati penhamba dziri padyo here?
y-m-11-01.s.s1.o.d: Pane makadhi matatu chete, saka hatigone kutaura kuti kune mutemo uye hatigone kuziva nhamba inotevera
y-m-11-01.s.s1.r.d: Hauna kushandisa mamiriro ekuti 'kune mutemo'. Kana kune mutemo, unogona kutsvaga mitemo inogoneka kubva pamakadhi matatu.
y-m-11-01.s.s1.explain: 2, 4, 8 zvinogona kugadzirwa nemutemo 'wanza nhamba iri pamberi ka2,' uye nemutemo 'nhamba inowedzerwa kunhamba iri pamberi inokura ne 2, se 2, 4'. Nhamba inotevera inosiyana zvichienderana nemutemo, saka zvakaoma kutaura kuti i 16 kubva pamakadhi matatu chete.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.prompt: Ngatiedzei mashoko aJihu. Gadzira nhamba 2 dzakasiyana dzinogona kuuya mushure me 2, 4, 8. Nhamba inotevera inofanira kutevera umwe wemitemo iyi: (가) mutemo unowanza nhamba iri pamberi ka kangani nguva imwe neimwe, kana (나) mutemo apo nhamba inowedzerwa kunhamba iri pamberi inowedzera nehuwandu hwakafanana nguva imwe neimwe.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wawana 'ka kangani' ne 'zvakawedzerwa zvakadini' kubva ku 2 kuenda ku 4 nekubva ku 4 kuenda ku 8.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora kuti unowana nhamba ipi kana ukashandisa mutemo mumwe neumwe ku 8 kamwe zvakare.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Nhamba inotevera i natural number yakakura kupfuura 8.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Ita nhamba inotevera natural number yakakura kupfuura 8.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.ok.c2: I nhamba inotevera umwe wemitemo miviri.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Nhamba iyi haiuye mushure me 2, 4, 8 nemutemo (가) kana mutemo (나). Shandisa mutemo mumwe nemumwe kamwe ku 8.
y-m-11-01.s.s2.explain: Nemutemo (가), kuwanza ka2, i 16, iri 8 yakawanzwa ka2. Nemutemo (나), apo nhamba inowedzerwa inowedzera ne 2 se 2, 4, 6, i 8+6=14. Kubva panhamba nhatu dzimwechete, nhamba inotevera inogona kusiyana.
y-m-11-01.s.s3.prompt: Jihu akataura mutemo mumashoko. “Nhamba inowedzerwa kunhamba iri pamberi inokura ne 2 nguva imwe neimwe.” Nemutemo uyu, nhamba iri pakadhi rinotevera mushure me 2, 4, 8 i ipi?
y-m-11-01.s.s3.hint.0: Uchitevera mutemo waunoudzwa, tanga wanyora nhamba dzakawedzerwa mu 2→4 ne 4→8.
y-m-11-01.s.s3.hint.1: Zvadaro, nyora kuti nhamba inowedzerwa inochinja sei uye uiwedzere ku 8.
y-m-11-01.s.s3.r.a: Uchiri kushandisa mutemo wekuenderera nekuwanza nhamba iri pamberi ka2. Mutemo waunoudzwa uri nezve nhamba inowedzerwa.
y-m-11-01.s.s3.r.b: Wakachengeta nhamba inowedzerwa pa 4. Mumutemo waunoudzwa, nhamba inowedzerwa yakasiyana nguva imwe neimwe.
y-m-11-01.s.s3.r.c: Iyi i pfungwa yekuenderera nenhamba dzinowedzerwa se 2, 4, 6.
y-m-11-01.s.s3.r.d: Wakawedzera 2 ku 8. Enderera nemuyerera apo nhamba inowedzerwa yakakura kubva ku 2 kuenda ku 4.
y-m-11-01.s.s3.explain: Kana mutemo wapiwa mumashoko, nhamba inotevera inogadzirwa seimwe chete. Nhamba dzinowedzerwa i 2, 4, 6, saka 8+6=14. Kana nhamba shoma chete dzapiwa, nhamba inotevera ingasagadzirwa seimwe chete, uye inogadzirwa kana wakaudzwa mutemo kana imwe nhamba inotevera.

y-m-11-07.goal: Tsvaga mutebhura hukama apo musiyano wakagadzikana unoramba wakafanana, seyemazera, wana makoshero, uye unyore patsva hukama hwakafanana nemashoko nemienzaniso inogona kunzwisiswa nemukoma wekwamai muduku weGiredhi 2.

y-m-11-02.title: Kutarisa equation yaMinsu mutebhura rebhokisi remaapuro
y-m-11-02.topic: Kuverenga kuenderana kwehuwandu huviri mutebhura uye kuinyora seequation (hukama hunokura nenhamba imwechete)
y-m-11-02.goal: Yedza equation iri yakarurama museru imwe chete yetebhura mumaseru ose uye uigadzirise, uye unyore hukama humwechete semaequations mumativi maviri.
y-m-11-02.material:
Vhengi remichero rinotengesa maapuro mumabhokisi. Bhokisi rimwe nerimwe rine maapuro akaenzana. Minsu akarongera huwandu hwemabhokisi nehuwandu hwemaapuro mutebhura.
Kana huwandu hwemabhokisi i 1, kune maapuro 5; kana huwandu hwemabhokisi i 2, kune maapuro 10; kana huwandu hwemabhokisi i 3, kune maapuro 15.
Minsu akati, “Kana ukawedzera 4 kuhuwandu hwemabhokisi, unowana huwandu hwemaapuro.”

Semhedzisiro, mutsetse 4 wakapa 7, asi tebhura inoti 15 kana pane mabhokisi 3. Mitsetse 1 ne 2 inotevedzera tebhura, saka yakanaka. Kuva yakarurama museru imwe hakureve kuva yakarurama mumaseru ose.

Ma equation maviri anotaura hukama hwakafanana kumberi nekudzosera shure. Mamwe ma equation akarurama mubhokisi rimwe kana maviri chete.

y-m-11-02.s.s3.model.0: Igadzirise kuita equation inowedzera huwandu hwemabhokisi ne5 (huwandu hwemabhokisi × 5 = huwandu hwema apple). Ndakatarisa kuti mabhokisi ose matatu etafura akarurama: 1×5=5, 2×5=10, 3×5=15.

y-m-11-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Pfungwa iyi inoedza kufunga kana chiratidzo chekuva odd chakakwana.

y-m-11-04.title: Kucheka bhuroko re3×3 kubva pa calendar
y-m-11-04.topic: Kuwana hukama pakati penhamba dziri padhuze nepamusoro napasi mumutsara wenhamba we calendar
y-m-11-04.goal: Gadzira mienzaniso yako kutarisa kuti huwandu hwebhuroko re3×3 mu calendar hunoita sema multiple enhamba yepakati, uye utsanangure nekuita mapeya kuti nei zvichishanda kunyangwe huwandu hwemabhokisi mumutsara huchichinja.
y-m-11-04.material:
Iyi ndiyo calendar yemwedzi une mazuva 31. 1 ndiSvondo, uye pane mabhokisi 7 mumutsara (Svo, Mun, Chipiri, Chitatu, China, Chishanu, Mugovera). Mutsara wekutanga ndi1~7, wechipiri ndi8~14, wechitatu ndi15~21, wechina ndi22~28, uye wechishanu ndi29, 30, 31. Kuenda bhokisi rimwe kurudyi kunoita nhamba ikure ne1, uye kuenda bhokisi rimwe pasi kunoita nhamba ikure ne7.
Harin akacheka chimiro che square (mabhokisi 9) chine mabhokisi 3 kubudikidza ne3 pasi pa calendar, akawedzera nhamba dzose 9, uye akati, “Zvinoita sema multiple enhamba yebhokisi repakati!”
y-m-11-04.thinking.1: Kutarisa mamiriro apo hukama hunoshanda (mabhokisi anokodzera mukati me calendar)
y-m-11-04.prereq.0: Kutarisa kuti nhamba dzinochinja sei bhokisi rimwe kurudyi nebhokisi rimwe pasi mumutsara wenhamba (nhanho ye 3rd–4th grade)
y-m-11-04.s.s1.prompt: Gadzira mienzaniso inotarisa chakacherechedzwa naHarin. Sarudza nhamba yebhokisi repakati m zvekuti mabhokisi ose 9 anokodzera mu calendar se square wemabhokisi akabatana, uye unyore huwandu s hwenhamba dzose 9. Gadzira mienzaniso 3 ine nhamba dzepakati dzakasiyana.
y-m-11-04.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza bhokisi rimwe repakati mu calendar, uye kutanga nyora mabhokisi matatu mumutsara wepamusoro, wepakati, newepasi imwe neimwe.
y-m-11-04.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora huwandu hwawakawana padivi penhamba yepakati uye uenzanise hukama hwezviviri.
y-m-11-04.s.s1.ok.c1: Mabhokisi 9 anokodzera mukati me 1 kusvika ku31 ye calendar.
y-m-11-04.s.s1.fail.c1: Mitsara iri pamusoro napasi pebhokisi repakati inofanira kuva mu calendar ose maviri. Sarudza nhamba yepakati zvakare.
y-m-11-04.s.s1.ok.c2: Mabhokisi 9 anobatana semabhokisi ari mumitsara imwe chete.
y-m-11-04.s.s1.fail.c2: Kana bhokisi repakati iri Mugovera kana Svondo, bhokisi riri kurudyi (kana kuruboshwe) rinopfuura kumutsara unotevera (kana wapfuura). Chinja zuva revhiki rebhokisi repakati.
y-m-11-04.s.s1.fail.c3: Huwandu hwemabhokisi 9 hwakasiyana nenhamba dziri mu calendar. Tarisa zvakare mabhokisi 8 akatenderedza bhokisi repakati.
y-m-11-04.s.s1.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana pakati ndi10, huwandu hwemabhokisi 9 ndi90, kune 13 ndi117, uye kune 18 ndi162. Mumienzaniso mitatu, huwandu ndi9 nguva nhamba yepakati. Kana bhokisi repakati iri Mugovera kana Svondo, mabhokisi 9 haabatani se square.
y-m-11-04.s.s2.prompt: Kana chakacherechedzwa naHarin chakarurama, huwandu hwaizova hwakadini mu calendar ine mabhokisi 5 mumutsara panzvimbo ye7 (mutsara wekutanga 1~5, wechipiri 6~10, …) kana mabhokisi 9 akakodzera se square?
y-m-11-04.s.s2.hint.0: Mu calendar ine mabhokisi 5, sarudza bhokisi rimwe repakati uye unyore nhamba dzemabhokisi ari pamusoro, pasi, kuruboshwe, nekurudyi.
y-m-11-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ita mapeya emabhokisi maviri ari kumativi akapesana ebhokisi repakati uye utsvage huwandu hwawo.
y-m-11-04.s.s2.o.a: Zvinoita sema multiple enhamba yepakati kana huwandu hwemabhokisi mumutsara huri 7 chete
y-m-11-04.s.s2.r.a: Unofunga kuti mutemo uripo nekuda kwenhamba 7. Mu calendar ine mabhokisi 5, nyora iwe pachako kuti mabhokisi ari pamusoro napasi akakura kana madiki kupfuura wepakati nezvakadini.
y-m-11-04.s.s2.o.b: Unoda kuziva huwandu hwemabhokisi mumutsara kuti usarudze kuti huwandu hwakawanda hwenhamba yepakati nguva dzingani
y-m-11-04.s.s2.r.b: Wakafunga kuti zvinoenderana nehuwandu hwemabhokisi. Isa huwandu hwemabhokisi pa5 uye unyore mabhokisi ari pamusoro napasi kutarisa zvinoitika.
y-m-11-04.s.s2.o.c: Kunyangwe mutsara une mabhokisi 5, huwandu ndi9 nguva nhamba yepakati
y-m-11-04.s.s2.r.c: Uku kutonga kunobva pakufunga kuti hukama pakati pemabhokisi ari pamusoro napasi hunogona kuva hwakafanana kunyangwe huwandu hwemabhokisi huchichinja.
y-m-11-04.s.s2.o.d: Kana mutsara une mabhokisi 5, inova 5 nguva nhamba yepakati
y-m-11-04.s.s2.r.d: Wakafunga kuti huwandu hwemabhokisi mumutsara hunowedzerwa zvakananga mukuwedzera. Wedzera nhamba 9 iwe pachako mu calendar ine mabhokisi 5 kuti utarise.
y-m-11-04.s.s2.explain: Chero mutsara une mabhokisi mangani, uchitora bhokisi repakati sechekutarisa, mabhokisi ari pamusoro napasi anoita peya diki neyakakura nehuwandu hwakafanana, uye mabhokisi ekuruboshwe nekurudyi anoitawo peya. Huwandu hwepeya ndi2 nguva nhamba yepakati, saka mapeya 4 kuwedzera wepakati ndi9 nguva nhamba yepakati.
y-m-11-04.s.s3.prompt: Harin anozvibvunza kuti nei. Kana nhamba yepakati iri m, ita mapeya emabhokisi maviri maviri kana kuaunganidza mutsara mumwe panguva, uye utsanangure kuti nei huwandu hwemabhokisi 9 huri multiple yenhamba yepakati.
y-m-11-04.s.s3.hint.0: Enzanisa huwandu hwemabhokisi maviri ari kumativi akapesana ebhokisi repakati nenhamba yepakati.
y-m-11-04.s.s3.hint.1: Unganidza mutsara mumwe (mabhokisi matatu kubudikidza) panguva imwe uye uenzanise huwandu hwawo nenhamba iri mubhokisi repakati.
y-m-11-04.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Nenhamba yepakati m, bhokisi riri pamusoro nebhokisi riri pasi ndi ...
y-m-11-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora pachena mabhokisi api anoita peya, zvichibva panhamba yepakati here?
y-m-11-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora 'nei zvakadaro' nemashoko anoshanda kubhokisi ripi neripi, kwete muenzaniso mumwe chete here?
y-m-11-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakaona here kuti pane imwe nzira yekutsanangura (kuunganidza mitsara)?
y-m-11-04.s.s3.model.0: Nenhamba yepakati m, bhokisi riri pamusoro, m-7, kuwedzera bhokisi riri pasi, m+7, ndi2m. Kuruboshwe m-1 nekurudyi m+1 zvakare ndi2m, uye mapeya ari pama diagonal maviri ndi2m zvakare. Pane mapeya 4, saka 8m, uye kuwedzera m yepakati kunopa 9m, ndiko kuti, 9 nguva nhamba yepakati.
y-m-11-04.s.s3.model.1: Kana ukawedzera mabhokisi matatu kubudikidza, mativi maviri ari 1 pasi ne1 pamusoro, saka ndi3 nguva bhokisi repakati. Mabhokisi epakati emitsara mitatu ndi m-7, m, m+7, uye huwandu hwawo ndi3m. Saka zvose ndi3 nguva 3m, iyo ndi9m, ndiko kuti, 9 nguva nhamba yepakati.

y-m-11-05.title: Kana divi rimwe rakaita kaviri, rimwe divi rinoitawo kaviri here?
y-m-11-05.topic: Kuenzanisa kuti huwandu hwumwe hunochinja sei kana humwe hwehuwandu huviri hunochinjana pamwe chete huchiita kaviri
y-m-11-05.goal: Pakati petafura ina, sarudza nyaya apo divi rimwe rinoita kaviri chaizvo kana divi rimwe rakaita kaviri, uye utsanangure nemuenzaniso unopikisa kuti kuva kwakarurama munyaya mbiri hakureve kuva kwakarurama munyaya dzose.
y-m-11-05.material:
Mina akati, “Kana zvinhu zviviri zvichichinja pamwe chete, kana divi rimwe rakaita kaviri, rimwe divi rinoitawo kaviri zvechokwadi!” Unoda kutarisa nekutarisa matafura emamiriro ana. (Makosha ose anotevera mutemo wakatarwa.)
- Mapencil: pencil 1 ndi500 won, mapencil 2 ndi1000 won, mapencil 4 ndi2000 won
- Kutumira: 1kg 3000 won, 2kg 4000 won, 4kg 6000 won
- Nzvimbo ye square: kana divi riri 1cm, 1cm²; kana 2cm, 4cm²; kana 4cm, 16cm² (inoverengwa square centimeters)
- Perimeter ye square: kana divi riri 1cm, 4cm; kana 2cm, 8cm; kana 4cm, 16cm
y-m-11-05.thinking.1: Kutsvaga gwara munharo inoita generalization kubva panyaya mbiri
y-m-11-05.prereq.0: Kuverenga mutafura kuti huwandu huviri hunochinja sei pamwe chete (nhanho ye 3rd–4th grade)
y-m-11-05.s.s1.prompt: Mune tafura imwe neimwe, nhamba yekutanga yakaita kaviri kubva ku1 kusvika ku2 uye kubva ku2 kusvika ku4. Sarudza mamiriro ose apo nhamba yechipiri inovawo 2 nguva chaizvo nguva mbiri dzose.
y-m-11-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kune tafura imwe neimwe, nyora kuti nhamba yechipiri inova nguva dzingani kana ichibva pabhokisi rekutanga ichienda kuchipiri.
y-m-11-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa bhokisi rechipiri kuenda kurechitatu nenzira imwe chete, uye uchengete matafura ari 2 nguva nguva mbiri dzose chete.
y-m-11-05.s.s1.r.a: Iyi sarudzo yakatarisa bhokisi nebhokisi kuti perimeter inovawo 2 nguva nguva mbiri dzose here kana divi rakaita kaviri.
y-m-11-05.s.s1.r.b: Tarisa kuti 3000 won inova nguva dzingani kana ichibva pabhokisi rekutanga ichienda kuchipiri.
y-m-11-05.s.s1.r.c: Pane bhokisi apo nzvimbo inova 4 nguva yakakura. Nyora kuti inova nguva dzingani mubhokisi rimwe nerimwe.
y-m-11-05.s.s1.r.d: Iyi sarudzo yakatarisa kuti, sezvo pencil imwe neimwe ine mutengo mumwe chete, kana huwandu hwakaita kaviri, mutengo unoitawo kaviri.
y-m-11-05.s.s1.explain: Mapencil ndi500 won, 1000 won, 2000 won, iyo ndi2 nguva nguva mbiri dzose, uye perimeter ndi4, 8, 16, zvakare 2 nguva nguva mbiri dzose. Kutumira kunobva ku3000 kuenda ku4000, iyo isiri 2 nguva, uye nzvimbo inobva ku1 kuenda ku4, iyo ndi4 nguva.
y-m-11-05.s.s2.prompt: Verenga nyaya yaMina uye usarudze mutsara unoomera kuvimba nawo.
y-m-11-05.s.s2.hint.0: Nongedza kuti mutsara mumwe nemumwe wakataurwa kubva patafura ipi.
y-m-11-05.s.s2.hint.1: Kune mutsara mumwe nemumwe, nyora kuti wakatarisa nyaya dzingani asati ataura saizvozvo.
y-m-11-05.s.s2.line.0: Pencil ndi500 won kune 1 ne1000 won kune 2, saka inoita kaviri.
y-m-11-05.s.s2.line.1: Perimeter ye square inoitawo kaviri kana divi rakaita kaviri.
y-m-11-05.s.s2.line.2: Mune zvese zviri zviviri, kana divi rimwe rakapetwa kaviri, rimwe rakapetwa kaviri futi.
y-m-11-05.s.s2.line.3: Saka, kunyange zvinhu zviviri zvichichinja pamwe chete sei, kana divi rimwe rapetwa kaviri, rimwe rinopetwa kaviri zvechokwadi.
y-m-11-05.s.s2.explain: Mutsara 4 ndiwo dambudziko. Mitsara 1~3 yakarurama chaizvo munyaya mbiri dzemapensera neperimeter. Asi kururama munyaya mbiri hakureve kuti zvakadaro zvechokwadi 'kunyange zvinhu zviviri zvichichinja pamwe chete sei'. Kutarisa tebhura imwe chete, yekutumira kana yenzvimbo, kunoratidza kuti hapapetwi kaviri.
y-m-11-05.s.s3.prompt: Ungaudza sei Mina? Uchishandisa nhamba dzetebhura yekutumira kana nzvimbo, tsanangura kuti mashoko aMina haagari akarurama, uye fungidzira unyore kuti chii chakafanana pamapensera neperimeter, apo 'kupeta kaviri kunopa kupeta kaviri'.
y-m-11-05.s.s3.hint.0: Mutebhura yekutumira, nyora mitengo ye1kg ne2kg padivi nedivi uye uwane kuti nguva dzingani.
y-m-11-05.s.s3.hint.1: Mumatebhura emapensera neperimeter, tarisa nhamba yechipiri kana nhamba yekutanga i1 uye ufananidze nematebhura mamwe maviri.
y-m-11-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mucounterexample yandakapa, zvakajeka here kubva panhamba kuti nhamba yekutanga inopetwa kaviri asi nhamba yechipiri haipetwi kaviri?
y-m-11-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora uchiziva kuti kururama munyaya mbiri hakuvimbisi 'zvechokwadi' here?
y-m-11-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakaedza fungidziro yako yezvakafanana pamapensera neperimeter nenhamba dzimwe here?
y-m-11-05.s.s3.model.0: Kune kutumira, 1kg i3000원, asi 2kg i4000원, kwete 6000원. Saka kunyange divi rimwe rakapetwa kaviri, rimwe haripetwi kaviri nguva dzose. Mapensera neperimeter zvinoita sezvinopetwa kaviri nokuti ihukama hwekuwanza hune kukosha kumwe chete kune chimwe nechimwe.
y-m-11-05.s.s3.model.1: Kune nzvimbo yesquare, kana divi richibva pa1cm kusvika ku2cm, nzvimbo inobva pa1cm² kusvika ku4cm², saka i nguva 4, kwete nguva 2. Saka mashoko aMina akaipa. Zvinoita sezvakarurama munyaya dzakadai seperimeter chete, apo inokura nehuwandu hwakafanana chaizvo nedivi.
